[26.1 更新移植说明](https://wiki.chaotictrials.de/porting/version/26.1/) **[![#与乌克兰同在](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshymanskyy/StandWithUkraine/main/banner2-direct.svg)](https://vshymanskyy.github.io/StandWithUkraine)** ![头部图片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/extra-disks/header.png) Extra Disks 是 [Refined Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/refined-storage) 的附属模组， 增加了容量大得多的物品与流体磁盘。

![概览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/extra-disks/overview.png) 你可以在每个对应的磁盘中存储无限数量的物品和流体。这应该足够存放……水和圆石了吧？ ![创造模式标签页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/extra-disks/creative_tab.png)
你可以将此模组放入任何你喜欢的整合包中。 ![[广告](https://www.bisecthosting.com/melanx)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/extra-disks/promo.png) #广告 #Ad
